Home / Loading-States / Offline State

Offline State

Informs users when they lose connectivity and provides guidance for recovery.

Offline Indicator Banner

A compact banner that appears at the top of the page.

You are currently offline. Some features may be unavailable.
HTML
<div class="zak-offline-banner">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
        <line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"/>
        <path d="M16.72 11.06A10.94 10.94 0 0119 12.55"/>
    </svg>
    <span>You are currently offline. Some features may be unavailable.</span>
    <button class="zak-offline-banner-close" onclick="this.parentElement.style.display='none'">&times;</button>
</div>

Offline State Page

A full-page offline state for when the app cannot function.

You're offline

It looks like you've lost your internet connection. Please check your network settings and try again.

HTML
<div class="zak-offline-state">
    <div class="zak-offline-state-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
            <line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"/>
            <path d="M16.72 11.06A10.94 10.94 0 0119 12.55"/>
            <path d="M5 12.55a10.94 10.94 0 015.17-2.39"/>
            <path d="M10.71 5.05A16 16 0 0122.56 9"/>
            <path d="M1.42 9a15.91 15.91 0 014.7-2.88"/>
            <path d="M8.53 16.11a6 6 0 016.95 0"/>
            <line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12.01" y2="20"/>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <h2 class="zak-offline-state-title">You're offline</h2>
    <p class="zak-offline-state-text">Please check your network settings and try again.</p>
</div>

Offline with Retry Button

Include a retry button to reconnect.

No internet connection

Please check your network settings and try again.

HTML
<div class="zak-offline-state">
    <div class="zak-offline-state-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
            <line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"/>
            <path d="M16.72 11.06A10.94 10.94 0 0119 12.55"/>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <h2 class="zak-offline-state-title">No internet connection</h2>
    <p class="zak-offline-state-text">Please check your network settings and try again.</p>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Retry Connection</button>
</div>

Offline with Cached Content

Inform users that cached content is available.

You're offline

You can still view previously loaded content. New changes will sync when you're back online.

HTML
<div class="zak-offline-state">
    <div class="zak-offline-state-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
            <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-4"/>
            <polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <h2 class="zak-offline-state-title">You're offline</h2>
    <p class="zak-offline-state-text">You can still view previously loaded content.</p>
    <div class="zak-offline-state-actions">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">View Cached Content</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline">Retry Connection</button>
    </div>
</div>

Network Status Dot

A small dot indicator for inline network status display.

Online
Offline
Connecting...
HTML
<span class="zak-status-dot zak-status-dot-online"></span> Online
<span class="zak-status-dot zak-status-dot-offline"></span> Offline
<span class="zak-status-dot zak-status-dot-connecting"></span> Connecting...

CSS Variables

HTML
:root {
    --zak-offline-banner-bg: var(--zak-warning);
    --zak-offline-banner-color: #000;
    --zak-offline-banner-padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    --zak-status-dot-size: 0.625rem;
    --zak-status-dot-online: var(--zak-success);
    --zak-status-dot-offline: var(--zak-danger);
    --zak-status-dot-connecting: var(--zak-warning);
}
